reason: I've had a dry cough, headache, aches, and feverish feelings for two days.
diagnosis: Likely COVID-19 infection, suggested by acute dry cough, headache, myalgias, feverish feeling, reduced appetite, and new loss of smell and taste with a household contact who recently had a cough/sore throat.
keyPoints: Symptom onset and progression over 1–2 days
Cough character and any sputum, blood, wheeze, or shortness of breath
COVID features: fever, loss of smell/taste, exposure to sick contacts, testing/isolation
Red flags: chest pain, confusion, dizziness/syncope, neck stiffness, worsening breathlessness
Associated ENT symptoms: sore throat, runny/stuffy nose
Systemic symptoms: myalgias, fatigue, appetite change, GI or urinary symptoms
Risk factors/comorbidities and smoking status; vaccination status
manner: worried about COVID, mildly anxious, cooperative, concise
transcript:
D: What brings you in?
P: Hi I umm, so I started to have this cough that started like 2 days ago and also these last couple of days I've just had this headache and feeling really achy all over.
D: OK, I'm sorry you said it started a day, two days ago?
P: Yeah, it's more like one to two days. All of this is kind of started. I think the the cough started 1st and then the headache and achiness has come after. I felt a bit feverish as well. I haven't checked my temperature but I, I felt feverish.
D: OK. The cough, is it dry, or are you bringing up any phlegm?
P: It's pretty dry.
D: Dry, OK, so no blood and no sputum?
P: No blood or sputum.
D: OK, do you feel short of breath?
P: No thats I haven't been short of breath.
D: OK, how about wheezing?
P: No wheezing.
D: OK. And any chest pain?
P: No, I haven't had any chest pains.
D: OK, alright. And the headache one to 10, 10 being the worst head, worst pain you've ever been in. How bad was it?
P: I'd say a four. It's just been kind of there the whole, so it's really annoying. I've tried some Tylenol and it's taken a little bit off the the I mean the edge off a little bit, but it's just been kinda there still.
D: OK. And is it a throbbing kind of pain or is it a dull, achy pain?
P: It's a kind of a dull, achy pain.
D: OK. Uhm, alright and where is it located?
P: Uh kind of in the front of uh I have my over my head and on both sides as well.
D: OK, OK. Any feelings of feeling like your heart's racing?
P: No, I haven't felt like that.
D: OK, any dizziness or fainting spells?
P: No, I haven't had anything like that.
D: Confusion or memory loss?
P: No, nothing like that.
D: OK, and any neck pain or stiffness?
P: No, nothing like that.
D: OK, running or stuffy nose?
P: No, my, I haven't had anything like that.
D: Sore throat?
P: No.
D: No, OK, how about that loss of smell or taste?
P: Uh yeah I have actually. Yeah, I have.
D: OK, both?
P: Yeah, both it's uh, I've actually yeah, I notice that in the last day, it's kind of weird. I didn't even think of it until you until you asked there.
D: OK.
P: But yeah, I have haven't really noticed being able to smell or taste.
D: OK, any changes in your vision or hearing?
P: No.
D: OK. Weight loss?
P: No weight loss, I've been, that's been stable. I wish.
D: OK and you mentioned you might have had a fever so we'll check your temperature today as well. Any fatigue?
P: Uh, not really. That's been OK, but been achey, so certainly doing less.
D: OK. Any rashes?
P: No rashes.
D: OK, any changes to your bowel movements?
P: No, that, everything has been normal there. I haven't had any diarrhea or no blood in the stool.
D: OK. Any nausea or vomiting?
P: No nausea or vomiting.
D: OK. Changes to your appetite?
P: Yeah, I've been, less interested in food for sure. I think I've been been, been, had a decreased appetite.
D: OK. Changes in your urine?
P: No, I haven't had any any pain or any anything changing to my urinary habits.
D: OK. Are you otherwise healthy? Do you have any longstanding medical conditions?
P: Uh, I I do have high blood pressure and high cholesterol and I take a statin as well as a what is it, an ACE inhibitor, I think, for the blood pressure, yeah.
D: OK, and are you up to date with your immunizations?
P: Uh, I am yes I think so.
D: Yeah, OK. Alright, and are you allergic to anything?
P: No, I don't think so.
D: No, OK. Alright, and any family history of lung or heart conditions.
P: No, nothing like that.
D: OK, umm, alright. Do you smoke?
P: I don't, no.
D: No, OK. Any other recreational drugs?
P: Uh, no.
D: OK. Do you drink alcohol?
P: Yeah, sometimes I'll have a glass of wine on the weekend or something like that, but that will just be one or two, maybe with dinner.
D: OK. And have you been in contact with anyone sick recently?
P: No, I I don't think so. I mean, I've been working from well, some days I've had to go into the office for work, but I've been mostly just working from, from home.
D: OK. OK. Uhm and where do you live right now?
P: So I live in a house downtown in the city here and I live with my wife and our two sons.
D: OK, any are they, they're ok, they're all healthy?
P: Uhm, yeah they they, they uh, well my son actually had a cough and a sore throat I think like last week or something like that but it just went it went away.
D: OK. Uhm, and do you have any old carpets? Asbestos, mold, anything like that in your home?
P: Uh, no, nothing like that.
D: No, OK. Uhm alright, I think those are all the questions that I had for you. Did you have any questions of your own for myself?
P: I was just well worried about Covid and was just wondering what I should do.
